summary: A son registers his elderly mother at reception: the patient is the mother (her name, age, gender, her own phone), the son is the emergency contact with his number, in-person consultation, walk-in, referred by the family doctor. Traps: the son's own age (thirty eight), name and phone must not become the patient's; the son declines to give his email for her, so email must stay empty; the son mentions his wife found the clinic on Google, but the referral is the family doctor.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Namaskaram sir. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Namaskaram. We want to see the skin doctor today. It is for my mother, not for me.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Okay sir. Do you have an appointment?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: No, we didn't book. We just came directly. Our family doctor, Doctor Rao in Kukatpally, told us to show here. He wrote a letter also.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: No problem sir, we can register her as a walk in. Doctor is in the clinic, there are two patients before you. Is this her first visit here?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Yes, first time.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Okay. Patient's full name please?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Padmavathi. Surname Gundlapalli.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Sorry sir, can you spell the surname?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: G, U, N, D, L, A, P, A, L, L, I. Gundlapalli.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: And Padmavathi with a V?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Yes, P, A, D, M, A, V, A, T, H, I.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Thank you. Her age?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Amma, how old are you now? Sixty four, no?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sixty four. In March I will be sixty five.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Sixty four, female. Does she have her own mobile number, or should I put yours?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: She has her own phone, a small button phone. Amma, tell your number.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nine six one eight, four seven two, three zero five.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Nine six one eight four seven two three zero five. Okay. And emergency contact? Your name and number, sir?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Yes, put me. Srinivas, her son. My number is nine eight eight five zero, one two seven four three.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Srinivas, son, nine eight eight five zero, one two seven four three.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Correct. Actually I am thirty eight, if you need my age also for the form.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: No sir, only patient details are needed. Her address?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: House number twelve, Vivekananda Nagar, Kukatpally, Hyderabad.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Okay. Email ID? For sending reports and prescriptions.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: She doesn't use email. Mine is there, but it is better you don't put my email for her. Just leave it, I will collect the reports here.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: No problem, I will leave email blank. Does she have an ABHA health ID card?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Not yet. We have to make it.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Okay, you can make it later. Will she consult in person today, or online video consultation?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: In person only. She is here, she can't do video properly.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Offline consultation. And you said Doctor Rao referred you, correct?

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: Yes, Doctor Rao sent us. My wife also saw your clinic on Google, but we came because of the doctor's letter.

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Okay, referral by doctor. Please give me that letter, I will attach it to her file. Consultation fee is five hundred, you can pay by UPI or cash.

turns.speaker: attendant
turns.text: UPI is okay. Amma, sit here, it will take some time.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay ra. Is the doctor a lady doctor?

turns.speaker: receptionist
turns.text: Yes amma, a lady doctor. Please sit, I will call Padmavathi garu when it is your turn.
